name: Accessible Menu Bootstrap 5
description: Submodule of Accessible Menu: registers a Bootstrap 5 library variant plus navbar templates and an "Expand at" breakpoint setting.
library_dependencies: accessible-menu-bootstrap-5 (accessible-menu-bs5, ISC) — loaded from a CDN (jsDelivr/unpkg) or a local /libraries copy; Bootstrap 5 CSS/JS supplied by the theme
project_description: Accessible Menu Bootstrap 5 is a submodule of Accessible Menu that adds a Bootstrap 5 flavoured menu library. It registers a second accessible_menu_library plugin (accessible_menu_bootstrap_5) whose menu types use the Bootstrap5* constructors from the accessible-menu-bootstrap-5 JS package, ships navbar-oriented Twig templates, and extends the per-menu edit form with an "Expand at" responsive breakpoint (xs–xl) plus Bootstrap-appropriate default classes (collapse/collapsing). It depends on the parent accessible_menu module and expects Bootstrap 5 CSS/JS to be provided by the site theme.
